title: Bridgelet Core testnet contract-ID configuration
description: Schema for a filled-in Bridgelet Core testnet deployment record. Validate your own deployments/testnet.json (or a copy you maintain for integrators) against this schema to catch typos in contract IDs, keys and hashes before a test run fails deep inside an SDK call. A contract ID is a Stellar strkey: the letter C (contract) or G (public key) followed by 55 base32 characters (A-Z, 2-7), 56 characters total. Hex fields are lowercase/uppercase-safe 32-byte values (64 hex digits).

network.description: Network name. Must be the Stellar public testnet, whose passphrase is 'Test SDF Network ; September 2015'.

deployedAt.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of the deployment (for example, 2026-10-10T04:38:14Z).

contracts.description: Deployed contract addresses. Only ephemeralAccount and sweepController are part of the supported testnet deployment; reserveContract and accountFactory entries are not deployed or wired by scripts/deploy-testnet.sh. Keep them here for shape compatibility, but verify any value on-chain before relying on it.

ephemeralAccount.description: Address of the deployed ephemeral_account contract (a C... strkey, 56 characters).

sweepController.description: Address of the deployed sweep_controller contract (a C... strkey, 56 characters). This is the recommended entry point for sweeps.

reserveContract.description: Address of the reserve_contract, if one was deployed manually. Not part of the supported tooling; verify on-chain.

accountFactory.description: Address of the account_factory, if one was deployed manually. Not part of the supported tooling; verify on-chain.

config.description: Deployment-time configuration values written alongside the contract IDs. Keys and hashes must be exact-length hex; strkeys must be 56-character base32 values.

authorizedSigner.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key (64 hex digits) that sweep_controller verifies sweep signatures against.

creatorAddress.description: Stellar public key (G... strkey, 56 characters) that initialized sweep_controller.

reserveAdminAddress.description: Stellar public key (G... strkey, 56 characters) with admin rights over reserve_contract.

recoveryAddress.description: Stellar public key (G... strkey, 56 characters) used as the per-account recovery fallback at initialize().

ephemeralAccountWasmHash.description: 32-byte SHA-256 WASM hash (64 hex digits) of the deployed ephemeral_account binary. Compare with the on-chain code hash to confirm which source version is live.
